class.name: JRPGReferenceScanner
class.brief_description: Finds every use of a JRPG database ID and reports references to missing or cleared entries.
class.description: Scans the [JRPGDatabase] tables, type lists and system data for ID references: traits, effects, learnings, drops, enemy actions, troop members and page conditions, actor classes and initial equipment, skill, weapon and armor types, elements, animations and the starting party. Each reference is a [Dictionary] with [code]source[/code], [code]source_id[/code], [code]path[/code], [code]target[/code] and [code]target_id[/code]. [code]source[/code] and [code]target[/code] are table names (see [method JRPGDatabase.get_table_name]) or type lists ([code]elements[/code], [code]skill_types[/code], [code]weapon_types[/code], [code]armor_types[/code], [code]equip_types[/code]); System data references have the source [code]system[/code] and source ID 0. IDs 0 and below mean "none" and are never references. The database editor uses it to warn before clearing an entry or shrinking a table, and to list dangling references.

method.name: collect_references
method.description: Returns every reference in [param database], in table order and then entry order, with the System data last.

method.name: describe
method.description: Returns where a reference is and what it points to, for reports, for example [code]Skill 4, effects[1].data_id: state 12[/code].

method.name: find_dangling
method.description: Returns the references whose target does not exist, with [code]problem[/code] set to [code]missing[/code] (beyond the table or type list), or whose target was cleared, with [code]problem[/code] set to [code]blank[/code] (an entry or type without a name).

method.name: find_uses
method.description: Returns the references to entry or type [param id] of [param target], for example before clearing it.

method.name: find_uses_from
method.description: Returns the references to [param first_id] and higher IDs of [param target], for example before shrinking a table to [code]first_id - 1[/code] entries.
